summary: FEAT-005 meets FEAT-005.json, design section 8 and plan D-e. The group_images_fn hooks default to the old images[idx] path with no extra RNG draws (goldens max |diff| 0, TestResumeAndValidation/TestMixedTasks OK), so in-training validation is unchanged (H2/H4). The 11 presets are deterministic and random_* use the OD1 training distribution. PET parcel overrides resolve correctly through DK_PARCELS, and fine labels are only used through gathers (no one-hot). eval_run mirrors main.py's resume branch for the model, frozen stages, fingerprints and BN freeze. It restores ckpt/last without saving, and validate() has no checkpoint or log side effects. The real gate sets match _build_dali_data, and a failed gate exits 5. Synthetic sets are built once on the CPU, shared by both runs and named per preset, so the identity/frozen caches never mix presets. eval_synth.py imports no TF at --help. The SLURM wrapper follows the rules (qtim, rtx8000, 1 GPU, 3 CPU, 128G, 8 h, dry run). Tests were run and logged: test_eval_synth 14 OK including the e2e eval with run dir unchanged, the trainer subsets OK, test_slurm_scripts 46 OK, py3.8 ast OK. NITs: no local test of a passing sanity gate on real logged keys, and the L2/L1 cascade restore path is first exercised on the cluster.
